title: Splitting Patient Responsibility on a Primary-Adjudicated Line (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility)
content:
**Rule.** Under Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility the patient responsibility on a covered claim line adjudicated by a primary record is split into components in this order:

1. **Deductible component** — the smaller of the line's allowed amount and the deductible still unmet, the unmet deductible being the class's annual deductible less the record's deductible met to date.
2. **Coinsurance component** — the class's DME coinsurance percentage of the allowed amount left after the deductible component, rounded to the cent half up.
3. **Medicaid copay** — a Medicaid Fee-for-Service primary record that is not a QMB record carries instead a copay component of the class's per-line Medicaid copay per claim line, and no deductible or coinsurance.

**Out-of-pocket room.** When the class has an out-of-pocket maximum (a maximum above 0.00), the components together never exceed the room left under it — the maximum less the out-of-pocket amount already met — the reduction falling on the coinsurance component first, then the copay, then the deductible. Deductible amounts count toward the out-of-pocket amount met only when the class counts its deductible toward the maximum.

**Posting.** Each non-zero component posts as its own patient charge; a component of 0.00 is not posted. The deductible component also posts to the deductible met, and the coinsurance and copay components post to the out-of-pocket amount met, in the benefit year of the line's date of service.

**Covering record.** Charges post only on a coverage record whose coverage covered the line's date of service: the coverage record is in status active or terminated. The status, effective date and termination date are read from the system's coverage record that the charge is posted on.

**Lines outside the split.** Lines adjudicated as non-covered, upgrade differences and self-pay sales are not split by this policy; they post as a single charge of their own responsibility type under the equipment category's rules.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Inputs: a class with an annual deductible of 500.00 and a coinsurance percentage of 10, no out-of-pocket limit reached; the record shows 350.00 of deductible met; the line's allowed amount is 400.00.

| Step | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Deductible still unmet | 500.00 less 350.00 | 150.00 |
| Deductible component | smaller of 400.00 and 150.00 | 150.00 |
| Allowed amount left | 400.00 less 150.00 | 250.00 |
| Coinsurance component | 10 percent of 250.00 | 25.00 |

Two charges post: a deductible charge of 150.00 and a coinsurance charge of 25.00.

**Out-of-pocket variation (hypothetical).** Same line, but only 20.00 of room is left under the class's out-of-pocket maximum and the class counts its deductible toward it. The components (150.00 and 25.00) total 175.00, which exceeds the 20.00 of room by 155.00. The reduction falls on the coinsurance first (25.00 removed, leaving 0.00) and then on the deductible (130.00 removed, leaving 20.00). One deductible charge of 20.00 posts; the coinsurance component of 0.00 is not posted.
